pull_requests.title: Character 1 gloves, boots, and two-handed tools for the Level 1 test
pull_requests.head: alfred/character-1-final
pull_requests.body: ## Summary Playable Character 1 update for the Level 1 test on `alfred/character-1-final`. Not a visual approval. Kaleb still gives the pass/fail. - Each glove is one closed solid (palm, four fingers, separate thumb, shearling cuff) skinned to the existing hand and forearm. - Each boot is one closed solid with a cream cuff, skinned to the existing foot, toe, and calf. - The original one-piece parka back stays. A replacement back panel tore the shoulder open at the game camera and was removed. - Two-handed axe and pickaxe use palm sockets on `L_Hand` and `R_Hand`. Idle, walk, and run stay the existing clips. Chop, mine, and carry are added. A tree selects the axe. A rock selects the pickaxe. F still chops when the tree is the target. ## Tests Godot 4.7.2 headless, `HavenlineLevel1/tests`: - 36 suites passed with no extra flags, including hero locomotion (12/12), wood stock (19/19), resource tree, and integrated opening. - 4 suites refuse to run without a disposable profile. With that profile: active receiver 10/10, private persistence 0 failures, receiver adapter 29/29, disposable opening write exited 0. - New `tests/test_tool_autoselect.gd`: 19/19. Tree resolves to axe, rock resolves to pickaxe, chop and mine enter those states, mining does not grant wood. ## Honest checklist (game camera, not an approval) - Gloves: pass at the closer Level 1 angle (five fingers). They shrink to a few pixels in the full ortho-13 field. - Thumb: pass at that closer angle. Separate thumb on the closed glove. - Boots: pass. Brown, one piece, cream top. - Cuffs: pass. Cream shearling on the wrists and boot tops. - Rear garment: pass as the original continuous hooded back. The new panel was rejected after it opened a hole. - Two-handed grip: fail. Auto-select and the chop/mine states pass tests. In the renders the axe reads as a grey block and both hands are not clearly closed on the haft. The rig has no finger bones, so the gloves cannot curl. - Gait: pass for idle/walk/run playback (hero test). A mid-stride close-up was not captured, so stride clearance is not signed off. ## Artifacts Clip (~18s, 8 fps) and stills from the Level 1 camera direction: - `/opt/cursor/artifacts/character1-level1.mp4` - `/opt/cursor/artifacts/character1-turnaround-chop-mine.png` - `/opt/cursor/artifacts/character1-game-camera.png` - `/opt/cursor/artifacts/character1-turn-front.png` - `/opt/cursor/artifacts/character1-turn-back.png` - `/opt/cursor/artifacts/character1-turn-left.png` - `/opt/cursor/artifacts/character1-turn-right.png` - `/opt/cursor/artifacts/character1-chop.png` - `/opt/cursor/artifacts/character1-mine.png` Commit: `48c6c53a0dfda117ef12c68b32cfe2b3732d5239`

pull_requests.title: Start Havenline's native Godot Android migration without Unity
pull_requests.head: codex/havenline-godot-android
pull_requests.body:
Havenline's existing production path depends on Unity, while Kaleb now requires a completely independent Android build that preserves the original game and premium stylized visual standard.

This draft adds a standalone Godot 4.7.2 project and GitHub ARM64 build workflow. Historical Unity files remain outside the export root for provenance. The supplied Character 1 GLB and recovered distinct C2–C4 V7 files are preserved byte-for-byte. The original gameplay contract is retained, including unlimited carrying, proximity actions, furnace materials, rescue timing, construction, and first-wave prerequisites.

Validation completed locally:
- 24 actual Godot gameplay/save checks pass, including corrupt-save recovery and worker cargo persistence.
- The native scene imports and starts.
- Godot exports a signed ARM64 development APK; signature verification passes and no Unity/IL2CPP libraries are present.
- Real Vulkan Mobile frames were captured, including a 3840×2160 internal render at scale 1.0. This used a software renderer and does not establish Android 60 fps.
- The uploaded GitHub tree was verified against the complete local Git tree, including every binary asset.

GitHub validation also passed for head `adb8e4e4761a6a38965514d7e84a3885b2ba4f07`: [native Android build run](https://github.com/ksolo21-web/HAVENLINE/actions/runs/34081169033). The run independently checked assets, ran all 24 gameplay/save checks, launched the scene headlessly, exported ARM64, verified the APK signature, and uploaded its development artifact and logs. The artifact uses GitHub's synthetic PR merge SHA in its filename; the run identifies the source head above.

This is NOT the finished game. Native visual review failed: C2–C4 have no animation clips, the environment remains below the requested production standard, and rendered enemy/helper integration is incomplete. Complete action motion, independently reviewed rigs, approved production environments, the full defense loop, worker jobs/production chains, ten connected biomes/transport, weather/audio, Google identity/cloud saves, Android lifecycle, and sustained physical-device 4K/60 remain open.

The review scene is limited to integration work and stops before invisible wolf pressure. All original requirements remain recorded in Docs/AI/HavenlineProjectContext.md and HavenlineGodot/data/release-status.json. Production export stays blocked; the isolated development package is com.kaleb.havenline.review. Do not merge as a completed or visually approved release.

pull_requests.title: Add V7 direct Unity character review gate
pull_requests.head: agent/havenline-v7-unity-review
pull_requests.body:
## What changed
- Adds Unity's official `com.unity.cloud.gltfast` 6.19.0 package so the verified V7 GLBs can be imported directly in Unity 6000.5.6f1 without a lossy or fabricated FBX conversion.
- Adds `HavenlineV7CharacterReview`, a deterministic Editor/batch-mode gate that verifies the exact V7 file hashes and byte counts, requires the 52-joint skinned rig, rejects missing/error materials, records mesh statistics, and renders neutral front / 3-quarter / side / back plus stress-pose front / 3-quarter proof captures.
- Keeps `productionPromotionAllowed=false` and explicitly leaves the legacy `CharacterN_production.fbx` contract unsatisfied. This branch cannot auto-approve the characters.
- Documents the staging paths, exact hashes, run command, and remaining human/gameplay/shipping-animation truth gates.

## Why
V7 is already machine-valid and synthetic-pose-valid, but the next legitimate gate is Unity import/render/pose/gameplay review. Blender is not available in the current execution environment, and fabricating an FBX or silently renaming a GLB would be wrong. Direct import through Unity's official glTF package preserves the actual source and lets Unity become the rendering truth gate.

## Validation completed before opening this draft
- Verified all four materialized V7 GLBs match the recorded SHA-256 and byte sizes exactly.
- Verified the branch diff contains only the intended package, review script/meta, and documentation changes.
- The source V7 models retain the recorded 52-joint skins; Character 3's prior synthetic deformation gate passed before this branch.

## Validation still required
This is intentionally a draft because the current chat runtime does **not** expose a live Unity Editor. Before promotion/merge:
1. Put the exact V7 GLBs under `Assets/Havenline/Art/Characters/Staging/V7/`.
2. Let Unity resolve glTFast and compile the project.
3. Run `HAVENLINE > Characters > V7 > Validate + Capture Review Proof` (or the documented batch method).
4. Inspect the generated `Artifacts/HavenlineCharacterReview/V7/review.json` and all 24 captures.
5. Run shipping-animation clipping checks and gameplay-scale landscape-camera review.
6. Perform human side-by-side approval against all four approved turnaround sheets.

No character should be marked final until those gates pass.

pull_requests.head: havenline/permanent-native-material-critic-20261027
pull_requests.body:
## Permanent game-wide reference-to-native material quality gate

**User directive, 2026-10-27:** The cooker demonstrably does not match `18567.png`. Make an **independent, source-bound material critic permanent for every visual material and asset in Havenline**, not just the cooker. Existing technical passes are not visual approval.

### Scope and hard thresholds
- Applies to every new/modified model, surface material, textures, shader/variant, runtime material, terrain, snow/water, trees, structures, character, VFX, scene and UI surface.
- Requires actual original reference bytes **and actual native Godot rendered pixels**, all required camera/context views, source/candidate/scene hashes, per-slot coverage and source-camera alignment.
- Requires **separate independently run C1 + C2 vision reviews**, raw output and hashes, substantive per-asset observations. No builder self-review or synthetic score substitution.
- **Exact 10/10** on `reference_fidelity` and `visual_language`; **>=9.5/10 on all other visual axes**; **no averaging, missing slots/views, known discrepancies or unresolved defects**.
- Source evidence may live in a private workspace; **do not commit user images/videos**. Technical/geometry checks, isolated 4K previews and JSON fixtures cannot impersonate visual acceptance.
- `reference_style_lock.py` requires this private evidence for each modified material/path. `shipping_visual_gate.py signoff` rejects missing genuine-source independent C1/C2 release receipts and isolated/non-shipping captures.
- `inventory_shipped_visual_sources.py` generates exact-sha tracked visual source census including material-producing scripts; **T70 must cover all shipped materials before game-wide release**. Previously user-accepted source files remain untouched by policy-only edits, but are included in T70 and any changed/reopened candidate must requalify.
- Explicit owner signoff, whole-frame review and physical Android certification are **separate mandatory gates**.

### Checks
- Global test workflow: `.github/workflows/havenline-global-rendered-material-critic.yml`; adversarial synthetic tests for missing camera/material/reference bytes, source drift, fake reviewer records, low scores, raw hashes, missing receipts and full-game census.
- The corresponding isolated integration branch suite passed **46 tests** at [Actions run 40558343841](https://github.com/ksolo21-web/HAVENLINE/actions/runs/40558343841), prior to the new shipping-source census test additions. Dedicated-branch CI is the authoritative final premerge check.

### Boundaries
This PR is deliberately isolated from unfinished global baking [PR #103](https://github.com/ksolo21-web/HAVENLINE/pull/103) and unapproved T05 cooker [PR #101](https://github.com/ksolo21-web/HAVENLINE/pull/101). **No `HavenlineGodot/` shipping asset is edited. No current cooker independent 9.5+/10 verdict exists; it remains owner-rejected.**

Do not merge without checking that new hard gates do not inadvertently replace existing owner-approved artwork and that the dedicated CI workflow passes. Do not mark the current game visuals approved merely because this policy's tests pass.

# Build and continue Havenline

## Active source

Continue Level 1 development on **alfred/level-1-replacement**. The consolidated source snapshot is **2706cd6b0c6bfa7b4e8ad31d792a365aaf456d08**; the active branch may advance independently. Always resolve its actual head before starting another change.

The full game plan is [HAVENLINE_BUILD_PLAN_V2.md](Docs/Production/HAVENLINE_BUILD_PLAN_V2.md). [REPOSITORY_INDEX.md](REPOSITORY_INDEX.md) links the preserved task plans, completion records and reference material. The dated task-custody index explains historical status disagreements without rewriting the original records.

## Open the Level 1 checkpoint

Prerequisites declared by the preserved project: Python 3.11 or later, Git LFS for historical LFS-backed references, and Godot 4.7.2.

From the repository root:

    git lfs pull
    python3 HavenlineLevel1/tools/hydrate_assets.py

The hydration script verifies all four studio assets and reconstructs the exact furnace GLB from the three tracked parts. Open **HavenlineLevel1/project.godot** in Godot 4.7.2.

For the current combined river, camp, HUD and Character 1 preview, use the fresh disposable checkout and isolated-profile procedure in [HavenlineLevel1/README.md](HavenlineLevel1/README.md). Its exact scene is [integrated_opening.tscn](HavenlineLevel1/previews/integrated_opening.tscn). In that isolated desktop runner, launch it explicitly with:

    godot --path HavenlineLevel1 --scene res://previews/integrated_opening.tscn

Pressing F5 runs the deliberately unchanged V8 default scene, res://opening.tscn. It does not select the current combined preview. Preserve this source setting; consolidation does not change the game's main scene.

A disposable headless import uses:

    godot --headless --path HavenlineLevel1 --editor --import --quit

Read [HavenlineLevel1/README.md](HavenlineLevel1/README.md) and [ONE_CAMP_DESIGN.md](HavenlineLevel1/docs/ONE_CAMP_DESIGN.md), then the exact slice's verification record under HavenlineLevel1/docs. These commands open/import the checkpoint; they do not certify a full game, device build or visual pass.

## Preserve the two source roles

**HavenlineLevel1/** is the current isolated replacement. **HavenlineGodot/** remains the preserved prior integration source. Do not replace current Level 1 files with older runtime files simply because a historical task record says approved.

Historical T01–T11 closeout records, active visual holds and later prepared task packets stay distinct. After Level 1 is accepted, review T01–T11 against actual current evidence before continuing the task plan. Archival preparation does not activate later runtime tasks.

## Reference custody

Use the original reference-video lock and source manifests under Docs/Design/ReferenceVideoLock. Both original recording hashes and declared sizes are retained. Full privately held original-video/editable-source custody is still explicitly unverified.

Generated turnarounds, selected aliases, rejected versions and delivered references retain their filenames and provenance. Static reference approval is not native mesh, rig, animation or runtime approval.

## Recovery

[Source snapshots](Docs/RepositoryArchive/SOURCE_SNAPSHOT.json) bind every captured branch to its full SHA. [Media custody](Docs/RepositoryArchive/MEDIA_CUSTODY.json) binds original media paths, Git blobs, SHA-256 hashes and retained locations. Historical alternatives under Docs/RepositoryArchive are recovery/reference sources, not active runtime overrides.
